elko-new-market.h2: Elko New Market's Local Junk Removal Crew
paras: Elko New Market sits just southwest of Lakeville along I-35, close to our truck and the dump. That makes it one of the quickest places for us to get to, often the same day you text.

With so many newer homes and growing families, the jobs we see here are garage cleanouts, old furniture after an upgrade, basement clear-outs and move-out leftovers. We do all the lifting, load everything, and sweep up before we leave.
Text a few photos and we'll send a price, usually the same day. Elko New Market is in our home area, so there's no travel fee.

credit-river.h2: Junk Removal for Credit River Homes
paras: Credit River sits between Prior Lake and Lakeville, with big lots, big garages and outbuildings that collect years of stuff. That's exactly the kind of cleanout we like.
We haul old furniture, appliances, garage and shed contents, yard debris, playsets and whole-house estate cleanouts. Our crew carries everything out from wherever it is on the property.
Credit River is in our home area, so there's no travel fee. Text us photos and we'll send a price, usually the same day.
Hampton is a small Dakota County city off Highway 52, a short drive from our home base. We cover Hampton and the farms and acreages around it.
Jobs out here run from a single couch to full farmhouse, garage and outbuilding cleanouts. We do all the loading and hauling, and we donate or recycle what we can.
Hampton is in Zone 2, so a small travel fee applies to small jobs and shrinks as the load grows. It's free on a full load. Text a photo for a price.
We serve Jordan and the surrounding Scott County countryside along Highway 169. Garages, basements, sheds and whole-house cleanouts are the jobs we see most here.
Our two-person crew shows up on time, does every bit of the lifting and loading, and sweeps up before we leave. You just point at what goes.
Jordan is in Zone 3, so a travel fee applies, and it shrinks as your load grows. Text a few photos and we'll send the full price, travel included, before we come out.
New Prague, the Czech-heritage town on the Scott and Le Sueur county line, is part of our regular service area. We handle everything from one old appliance to a full estate cleanout.
We carry it out of the house, garage, basement or shed, haul it off, and donate or recycle whatever we can before anything goes to the dump.
New Prague is in Zone 3, so a travel fee applies, and it gets smaller the bigger the load. Text photos for a price with travel included.
Cannon Falls sits on the Cannon River along Highway 52, an easy run down from our home base. We clear homes, garages, basements, cabins and outbuildings across the area.
Bigger cleanouts are where we're most useful out here. We bring the truck, do every bit of the lifting, and leave the space swept.
Cannon Falls is in Zone 3, so a travel fee applies, and it shrinks as your load grows. Send a few photos and we'll text the full price before we come.
Dundas sits just south of Northfield along the Cannon River. We serve both towns, along with the homes and farms in between.
We haul furniture, appliances, mattresses, garage and basement contents, and whole-house cleanouts. Usable items get donated and recyclables get sorted out.
Dundas is in Zone 3, so a travel fee applies, and it gets smaller as your load grows. Text photos for a price with everything included.

st-louis-park.h2: Junk Removal for St. Louis Park Homes
paras: St. Louis Park sits just west of Minneapolis, with a mix of older homes, duplexes and apartments. That means a steady stream of move-outs, basement and garage cleanouts, and furniture that won't fit in the next place.
We carry everything out from any floor, load the truck and sweep up. Usable furniture gets donated and recyclables get sorted out before anything goes to the dump.
St. Louis Park is in our Zone 4, so a travel fee applies, and it shrinks as your load grows. It's lowest on full loads and whole-house cleanouts. Text a few photos for a price with travel included.
We serve Hopkins and the neighborhoods around Mainstreet, from single-item pickups to full house and garage cleanouts.
Our two-person crew does all the lifting, loading and hauling, and leaves the space swept. We donate or recycle what we can.
Hopkins is in our Zone 4, so a travel fee applies, and it gets smaller the bigger the load. Text photos and we'll send the full price, travel included, before we come out.
Golden Valley sits just northwest of Minneapolis along Highway 55 and I-394, with plenty of mid-century homes and big lots that collect years of stuff.
We handle garages, basements, estate cleanouts and furniture removal, carrying everything out ourselves and sweeping up after.
Golden Valley is in our Zone 4, so a travel fee applies, and it shrinks as your load grows. Text a photo for a price with travel included.
We serve Roseville and the surrounding Ramsey County suburbs north of St. Paul, from apartments to big family homes.
Move-outs, garage and basement cleanouts, old furniture and appliances: we load it all, haul it off and donate what's still usable.
Roseville is in our Zone 4, so a travel fee applies, and it gets smaller as the load grows. Send a few photos and we'll text the full price before we come.

wayzata.h2: Junk Removal for Wayzata and Lake Minnetonka Homes
paras: Wayzata sits on the north shore of Lake Minnetonka, and its big homes, garages and lake cabins tend to need big cleanouts. That's where we're most useful.
We handle whole-house and estate cleanouts, garages, boathouse and basement junk, and old furniture, with every bit of the lifting done by us.
Wayzata is in our Zone 5, so a travel fee applies, and it's smallest on full loads and whole-house jobs. Text us photos and we'll send the full price, travel included.
